jobs.description_text: This role sits within NCS AI Central's (AIC) Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model — the combined capability that takes AI solutions from proof-of-concept through to hardened production systems. As AI Engineer, you design and run rapid experiments on Gen AI models, prompts, and retrieval strategies to give the squad fast, evidence-based answers on model performance — operating primarily within fast-moving FDE engagements (POC/POV, pilot deployments). What will you do: 1. Experimentation & Evaluation Understand the business problem, POC objectives, and evaluation metrics. Design experiments to test different model configurations, prompts, or retrieval strategies. Analyse Gen AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and alignment with requirements; identify common failure modes (hallucination, bias, irrelevant answers, factual errors). Support SMEs in defining ground truth benchmarks for evaluation. 2. Data Preparation & Pipelines Profile and clean sample datasets for experimentation (lightweight data prep). Build and test simple pipelines for data ingestion, prompt construction, and output evaluation. 3. Gen AI & Agentic Techniques Work with foundation models via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Azure AI Foundry depending on engagement cloud posture. Apply working knowledge of China-origin models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) as increasingly relevant, cost-effective alternatives. Apply agentic orchestration frameworks such as AWS Strands, LangGraph, or equivalent, for designing and testing multi-step agent workflows. Apply prompt strategies, prompt engineering patterns, and RAG design (chunking, embeddings, retrieval evaluation); support ingesting/vectorising content to knowledge bases. Provide insights and recommendations to improve model performance in quick iterations, including fine-tuning approaches where applicable. 4. FDE & Development/Maintenance Coverage During FDE engagements: rapidly test candidate models, prompts, and retrieval strategies, giving the team fast, evidence-based go/no-go signals. During system development & maintenance engagements: support ongoing model/prompt tuning and monitoring as applications move toward production. 5. Collaboration Collaborate with developers on integrating models into the POC workflow, and work closely with PM, devs, and SMEs to refine data and prompts. Partner with the Data Scientist on evaluation methodology where classical statistical baselines are in play, and with the AI/LLM Specialist when an engagement moves toward production-grade evaluation. Document experiments briefly but clearly (hypothesis → result → conclusion). We are hiring at two levels for this role. All responsibilities above apply to both; the distinction is in scope of ownership, years of experience, and seniority of judgement expected. AI Engineer 4–5 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML or Gen AI engineering. Runs experiments and prototypes independently within a defined POC/POV scope, under guidance from a Senior AI Engineer or AI/LLM Specialist. Executes rapid experimentation cycles for one engagement at a time; escalates ambiguous evaluation calls to senior team members. Senior AI Engineer 6+ years of hands-on experience, including prior ownership of experimentation strategy for complex or ambiguous problem statements. Sets the experimentation approach across multiple engagements and mentors junior AI Engineers. Advises PMs and stakeholders directly on feasibility and experimentation trade-offs; represents technical experimentation findings in client conversations. Qualifications The ideal candidate should possess: 4+ years hands-on experience in AI/ML or Gen AI engineering (see Role Levels for the split between AI Engineer and Senior AI Engineer). Understanding of Gen AI concepts (tokenization, embeddings, RAG, prompting, evaluation). Familiar with at least one major cloud AI service (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Azure AI Foundry); working knowledge of others a plus. Working knowledge of the China AI model landscape (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) a strong plus. Familiarity with agentic orchestration frameworks (AWS Strands, LangGraph, or equivalent), for designing and testing multi-step agent workflows. Ability to do rapid experimentation rather than perfect models. Basic proficiency in Python and Gen AI tools (e.g., model SDKs, vector DBs). Analytical mindset: can quantify subjective output (accuracy, relevance, readability). Good data wrangling skills to prepare small datasets quickly. Preferred Qualifications Generative AI Leader or Machine Learning Engineer certification, or equivalent. Exposure to LLMOps practices (model monitoring, versioning) for production transition. Familiarity with model fine-tuning techniques. Exposure to Singapore Government GCC/HCC environments. Tech Stack (Illustrative) Languages: Python LLM Runtime: AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry; DeepSeek/Qwen/GLM (China stack) Agentic Frameworks: AWS Strands, LangGraph Data & Eval: Model SDKs, vector DBs, pandas/Jupyter-style tooling for experimentation Why Join NCS Lead high-impact AI management consulting programs for major enterprises and public sector clients. Shape enterprise strategies and governance frameworks that drive real transformation. Work with a talented, multidisciplinary team in a collaborative environment. Competitive compensation and strong professional development support. We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future. Together, we make the extraordinary happen. jobs.description_text: We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer specialising in Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI to design, develop, and deploy production-ready AI solutions. You will build and enhance GenAI-powered voice bots and chatbots using AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, and Amazon Connect, integrating MCP tools, knowledge retrieval pipelines, and AI guardrails. With strong Python engineering skills and a focus on security, performance, and scalability, you will work closely with client-delivery teams to deliver innovative, enterprise-grade AI solutions across NCS’s growing portfolio. What You'll Do Build and launch Architect and ship production-ready GenAI applications using LLMs, RAG and agentic AI. Create voice bots and web chatbots with Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon Connect and related AWS services. Engineer RAG pipelines end to end: document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval and response generation. Orchestrate agentic workflows and MCP integrations for secure tool calling, API connectivity and multi-step task execution. Configure AI agents with Bedrock AgentCore, adding tool integration, memory, identity and observability. Choose the right foundation models by weighing response quality, latency, cost and deployment needs. Design conversations that flow naturally, with multi-turn interactions, context management, fallback handling and smooth handover to human agents. Bring voices to life by integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech and streaming where needed. Build backend services and REST APIs with Python, FastAPI, Flask, AWS Lambda and Amazon API Gateway. Apply ML and NLP techniques such as classification, regression, entity extraction, text processing and summarisation where they add value. Protect and prove Safeguard every response with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails and application-level controls against hallucinations, prompt injection, harmful outputs and unsupported answers. Protect Client data with PII detection and redaction, access management and data residency compliance. Craft evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, relevance, groundedness and retrieval quality, using tools like RAGAS, DeepEval or promptfoo. Stress-test AI applications and integrations through functional, integration, regression, performance, security and end-to-end testing. Write clean, modular, testable Python, backed by Git, code reviews and automated testing. Run, refine and scale Keep a close eye on production performance, diagnose failures and lift response quality, retrieval accuracy, latency, reliability and cost efficiency. Instrument everything with logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerting via Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools. Automate deployments across environments with CI/CD pipelines, Docker and AWS deployment services. Pinpoint and resolve issues across LLMs, RAG pipelines, MCP tools, Amazon Connect, AWS services, APIs and backend integrations. Fine-tune prompts, retrieval strategies, model selection, context use and tool execution for better results at lower cost. Collaborate and grow Partner with architects, developers, QA, DevOps and Client stakeholders to turn business needs into AI solutions that work in the real world. Document solution architecture, agent workflows, MCP integrations, API specifications, test and deployment processes, operational guidelines, and experiment results, clearly and concisely. Keep your finger on the pulse of GenAI, agentic AI, RAG, MCP, foundation models and AWS AI services, and bring the best new ideas to Team NCS. What You Bring Experience and education 2–5 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering or data science. 2–3 AI/ML projects delivered beyond notebooks, ideally involving application integration, deployment, production support or ongoing optimisation. 1–2 GenAI applications built and deployed, such as RAG chatbots, LLM integrations, AI agents or enterprise knowledge retrieval. Production-oriented GenAI work in Python, connecting LLMs to APIs, external tools, databases or enterprise systems. Technical skills Strong Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow), with a habit of writing modular, testable, production-ready code. Hands-on command of GenAI concepts: LLM APIs, foundation models, prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management and tool calling. Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock or Azure OpenAI (or equivalent). Sound judgement on RAG architecture: chunking strategies, embedding model selection, vector store configuration and retrieval quality evaluation. Practical experience with at least one vector database (Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or equivalent). Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) for model training or deployment. Proficiency with Git, CI/CD basics and Docker. Fluency in at least one more language (TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, or advanced SQL). What Will Make You Stand Out Voice AI experience with a pro-code approach (Twilio, Amazon Connect, Deepgram, Whisper + TTS pipelines). This is a significant differentiator. Exposure to agentic patterns such as tool-calling agents, ReAct loops, multi-step planning or reflection mechanisms. Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks. Experience with RAG and GenAI evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, promptfoo). Knowledge of responsible AI: bias detection, fairness metrics and output guardrails. Exposure to NLP pipelines: entity extraction, text classification and summarisation. Experience in an SI, consultancy or multi-client delivery environment. What We're Looking For in a Person You are a T-shaped professional: broad across AI/ML, software engineering, and data, with deep expertise in at least one area of AI engineering (e.g., LLM application development, classical ML at scale, or NLP). You are intellectually curious, rigorous about evaluation, and care about shipping things that actually work in production — not just in notebooks. Why NCS? Work on real, production AI systems — not sandboxed experiments. Your code ships to government agencies, financial institutions, and enterprise clients across APAC. Learn from a practice of 20+ AI engineers and data scientists with deep expertise spanning ML, GenAI, agentic AI, and cloud-native architecture. Accelerate your career: NCS invests in structured mentorship, certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), and a clear seniority path from engineer to architect. Gain early exposure to cutting-edge agentic AI and voice AI projects that few engineers at your level will encounter elsewhere in the market. What can a career at NCS offer you? We don’t just dream of making the world a better place. We make it happen. We believe that when you join NCS, you can: Make A Difference - Play a part in large-scale, innovative and game-changing transformation programs that directly impact and advance the communities we live in. Elevate Yourself and Stay Relevant – Continuously challenge and upskill via career development and training programs in hot areas such as 5G, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence and cloud. Pivot with Ease – There are multiple career pathways for vertical advancement or lateral moves so you can explore different career options throughout your time here at NCS. Collaborate & Network – You will learn from some of the brightest minds in the industry and work with talented individuals from diverse and broad set of backgrounds. We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. jobs.description_text: Centre of AI in Medicine is a university-level research centre with the mission to bridge the gap between cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and practical applications in healthcare, The key objective is to spearheadresearch and development to revolutionise patient care and inform public health policies. For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/c-aim We are seeking a Research Assistant / Research Associate to contribute towards the daily operational needs and strategic research priorities of the NTU Centre of AI in Medicine (C-AIM). The role will support the smooth running of C-AIM’s infrastructure, AVIT systems, administrative processes, procurement, audits, documentation, and coordination activities, ensuring that the Centre’s day-to-day functions are reliable, efficient, and responsive to project and stakeholder needs. In parallel, the candidate will provide behavioral, communications and social science research support for strategic healthcare AI implementation projects, including human-machine interactions, outcomes-based evidence, survey design and rollout, cohort recruitment, conversational analysis, simulation- and observation-based studies, data preparation, processing and analysis, project documentation, grant and proposal support, and coordination with internal and external collaborators. Through this dual operational and research-facing role, the candidate will help C-AIM translate AI innovations into practical healthcare applications that advance patient care, health system improvement, and responsible AI implementation in medicine. Primary responsibilities: Daily Operations, Infrastructure and AVIT Support Manage, operate and maintain C-AIM’s AVIT, computing and infrastructure resources, including microaccess laboratories and AI simulation rooms, to ensure readiness for meetings, events, demonstrations, teaching, research activities and stakeholder engagements; Provide day-to-day technical support, troubleshooting and liaison with institutional teams, vendors and service providers for equipment setup, servicing, procurement and upgrades; Maintain inventories, usage records, documentation and operational trackers to support efficient centre operations, audit readiness and continuity of services. Behavioural, Communication and Social Science Research Support Support healthcare AI implementation studies that examine human-machine interaction, communication practices, user behaviour, trust, acceptability, adoption, workflow fit and outcomes-based evidence in clinical, educational or organisational settings; Assist with the design, rollout and monitoring of surveys, interviews, focus groups, observational studies, simulation-based studies and conversational analysis protocols related to AI use in healthcare; Coordinate participant or cohort recruitment, consent-related documentation, scheduling, data collection logistics and follow-up activities for behavioural, communication and social science research components; Prepare, clean, organise and analyse qualitative, quantitative or mixed-methods data, including survey responses, observational notes, transcripts, interaction logs and implementation outcome measures. Healthcare AI Implementation and Project Support Support strategic healthcare AI implementation projects by assisting with needs assessment, workflow mapping, stakeholder documentation, user feedback collection and translation of research findings into practical implementation recommendations; Assist with data preparation, processing, analysis, evaluation and documentation for AI-enabled healthcare projects, ensuring that technical outputs are interpreted alongside behavioral, communication and organizational considerations; Contribute to the development, testing and evaluation of AI/ML workflows, prototypes, dashboards or tools that support responsible deployment, monitoring or evaluation of AI applications in healthcare settings; Support deployment, testing and maintenance of AI/ML applications on suitable institutional or cloud-based platforms, in coordination with relevant technical, governance and stakeholder teams. Research Coordination, Documentation and Communication Prepare and maintain research protocols, study materials, implementation notes, project reports, presentation materials and progress updates for C-AIM projects; Coordinate communication across research teams, clinical or institutional collaborators, external partners, vendors and administrative units to support timely project delivery and clear stakeholder engagement; Support the preparation of grant applications, research proposals, conference materials, posters, manuscripts, ethics submissions and other outputs arising from healthcare AI implementation and social science research work. Research Administration, Compliance and Centre Support Handle procurement, purchase requests, vendor coordination, asset tracking and resource planning for both routine centre operations and research project needs; Support audits, compliance checks, institutional reporting and documentation processes to ensure alignment with NTU, C-AIM and project governance requirements; Assist with research and legal agreements, project records, ethics or governance submissions where applicable, and coordination of administrative workflows required for collaborative healthcare AI projects; Coordinate with finance, procurement, human resources, estates, IT and other administrative departments to resolve operational matters and support smooth centre functioning. Required Competencies and Qualifications: Bachelor’s (for Assistant) or Master’s (for Associate) degree in Social Sciences, Communications, Psychology, Behavioral Science, Sociology, Economics, Econometrics, Public Health, Health Services Research, Implementation Science, Health Informatics, Data Science, or a closely related discipline relevant to behavioral, communication and healthcare AI implementation research. Training or experience in behavioral, communication, psychology, social science or econometric research methods, including survey design, interviews, focus groups, observational studies, simulation-based studies, conversational analysis, implementation evaluation or mixed-methods research. Ability to support healthcare AI implementation studies examining human-machine interaction, user behavior, trust, acceptability, adoption, communication practices, workflow fit and outcomes-based evidence in healthcare, education or organizational settings. Competence in preparing, cleaning, organizing and analysing qualitative, quantitative or mixed-methods data, including survey responses, interview or focus group transcripts, observational notes, interaction logs and implementation outcome measures. Familiarity with statistical, qualitative or econometric analysis tools such as R, Python, Stata, SPSS, NVivo, ATLAS.ti, Excel or equivalent platforms is advantageous; willingness to learn additional data analysis or healthcare AI tools is expected. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare research protocols, study materials, reports, grant or proposal inputs, presentations, ethics documents and stakeholder-facing updates clearly and accurately. Good interpersonal and coordination skills, with the ability to liaise professionally with research teams, clinical or institutional collaborators, study participants, vendors and administrative units across multidisciplinary healthcare AI projects. Practical ability or willingness to support daily centre operations, including AVIT setup, equipment readiness, infrastructure coordination, inventory tracking, procurement documentation, audit preparation and liaison with vendors or institutional service teams. Experience or willingness to learn research administration processes, including participant or cohort recruitment, consent-related documentation, ethics or governance submissions, project reporting, compliance documentation, grant support and research agreement coordination. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and interest in healthcare, AI in medicine, responsible AI implementation, digital health, health communication, behavioural science or health system improvement. Hiring Institution: NTU

jobs.description_text: Join Our Multidisciplinary Team at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore These cluster hires will contribute to an integrated programme spanning fault assessment, seismic and geodetic monitoring, earthquake physics, ground-motion modelling, site response, exposure and vulnerability, and probabilistic seismic hazard and risk assessment, working to strengthen Singapore’s national capabilities. New hires will join a multidisciplinary research team spanning Nanyang Technological University’s Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS), Asian School of the Environment (ASE), and School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE). For more information, please visit: https://earthobservatory.sg , https://ntu.edu.sg/ase , and https://ntu.edu.sg/cee . We are looking for Research Associate / Research Engineer II: Research Associate (Fault-Zone Analysis in Bedrock) We are looking for a Research Associate to support a multidisciplinary geoscience research programme focused on the characterization of geological materials and the investigation of fault-zone processes in the subsurface, with the end goal of assessing fault behaviour and geological evidence of past deformation. The role will contribute to sample characterization; laboratory investigations including geochemical, mineralogical, microstructural, geomechanical, and/or geochronological testing; and integrating the results into fault-zone interpretation. Key Responsibilities: Conduct routine geological logging, sample screening, and preliminary characterization of rock materials Support inventory, prioritisation, preparation, scanning, and digital archiving of priority bedrock cores Assist in identifying and selecting core intervals for follow-up detailed analysis Prepare samples of fault-zone materials and fractured bedrock for geochemical, mineralogical, microstructural, geomechanical, and geochronological testing, and support laboratory analyses Coordinate logistics related to sample handling, transportation, storage, and laboratory activities Support structural and mineralogical interpretation of faulted and fractured core intervals Assist with data collection, quality control, processing, visualization, and management of scientific datasets Maintain research databases, metadata records, and project documentation Support preparation of technical reports, conference abstracts, presentations, and scientific manuscripts Work closely with research staff, collaborators, and laboratory personnel to ensure timely delivery of project objectives Job Requirements: Master’s degree in geology, geoscience, Earth science, geological engineering, or a related field is required; a Master’s thesis focused on petrology, mineral characterization, geochemistry, geochronology, structural geology, or related geoscience topics would be advantageous Experience in geochronological, geochemical, mineralogical, microstructural, or geomechanical laboratory work, and/or familiarity with identifying minerals suitable for geochemical or geochronological investigations Academic background in petrology, mineralogy, geochemistry, geochronology, structural geology, or closely related fields would be advantageous Experience with scientific data management and analysis is required; experience with core handling, sample preparation, scanning, laboratory workflows, or geological data management would be advantageous Good written and oral communication skills, including the ability to prepare technical reports for review by external experts Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary collaborative team, and to manage multiple concurrent laboratory workflows Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with meticulous attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate sample and data records Entry-level candidates are welcome to apply where they can demonstrate the required technical background and relevant experience Interested candidates should submit the following documents: A current curriculum vitae (CV) A succinct cover letter (not more than one page) detailing research interests and relevant experience The name and contact information for 2–3 references; institutional e-mail addresses are preferred, but other addresses will be accepted with suitable explanation If the candidate has relevant publications, they may include web links (URLs) in the CV or as an annex to the cover letter (this will not count toward the one-page limit) We seek a diverse and inclusive workforce and are committed to equality of opportunity. We welcome applications from all and recruit on the basis of merit, regardless of age, race, gender, religion, marital status and family responsibilities, or disability. We regret to inform you that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

jobs.description_text: The School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) at NTU, established in 1981, aims to be a world-leading school in sustainability and the built environment, addressing urbanisation and climate change through research and innovation. Do you want to use the latest artificial intelligence to tackle grand societal challenges such as climate change and urbanization? We are looking for a Research Fellow in Trustworthy Machine Learning for Earth Observation to develop trustworthy machine learning models to tackle those problems using satellite image time series and geospatial data. Current geospatial deep learning models, especially foundation models, lack high-quality uncertainty quantification to be applicable in many real-world applications. The Research Fellow will develop trustworthy models to apply on problems like aboveground biomass estimation and hazard monitoring in coastal region. The Research Fellow will also have the opportunity to explore emerging directions in machine learning for Earth observation, such as vision–language models, agentic AI and generative models. Key Responsibilities: Develop trustworthy deep learning models for multimodal Earth observation data, especially in regression problems. Develop more actionable geospatial foundation models for real-world applications. Apply the models to real-world problems such as aboveground biomass estimation. Explore vision–language models, agentic AI and generative models for Earth observation. Build scalable and reproducible processing pipelines on high-performance and cloud computing and maintain open-source code and datasets. Prepare data and reference labels, evaluate models and maintain open-source code. Contribute to project tasks, including preparing deliverable and report, and participating in meetings Support the research group in teaching and daily operation. Job Requirements: PhD's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, remote sensing, geomatics, civil and environmental engineering, data science, or a related field. Knowledge of deep learning and geospatial foundation models, demonstrated through coursework, theses, projects or publications. Experience with time-series models, vision–language models, generative models or AI agents is an advantage. Experience with satellite remote sensing or other geospatial data. Good written and oral communication skills. Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch), and familiarity with geospatial libraries (e.g. GDAL, rasterio, xarray) and Linux/GPU computing; Competent in analysing, visualising and communicating results. Self-driven, and spirit of teamwork. Ability to work independently and in a team, well organized and able to meet deadlines. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

jobs.description_text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Principal Engineer with a deep expertise in autonomous AI agent architecture and deployment, to spearhead the design, development, and optimization of intelligent agent systems on our global crypto exchange platform. This is a senior role requiring a hands-on AI science background combined with strategic oversight, technical direction, and cross-functional collaboration.
You will work at the cutting edge of AI and crypto, designing AI agents that can autonomously reason, act, and evolve in complex, real-time environments such as trading, security, compliance, and customer interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead the design, development, and lifecycle management of autonomous AI agents tailored to crypto exchange operations (e.g., customer assistant, trading bots, risk detection agents, fraud prevention agents, etc.).
  • Architect multi-agent systems (MAS) and frameworks to support goal-directed, reasoning, planning, and reinforcement-learning-based agents.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, business, and operation teams to define agent roles and measurable KPIs.
  • Drive experimentation, simulations, and continuous learning pipelines for agent performance optimization.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on developments in AGI, LLM-integrated agents, and cognitive architectures; apply relevant innovations to production systems.
  • Mentor and lead a team of AI scientists and engineers; help define the AI roadmap and research strategy.
  • Ensure system scalability, security, and regulatory compliance of AI-powered solutions in the crypto exchange domain.

What We Look For In You

  • PhD or Master's in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Robotics or related field with at least 10 years of industry experience.

  • Proven experience building and deploying autonomous AI agents in live environments. Ideal candidates will have:
    • Designed multi-agent frameworks or agent ecosystems (e.g., AutoGPT, OpenAgents, LangGraph, LangFuse, Dify, Coze, etc.).
    • Experience with goal-oriented agents, context engineering, memory management, tool use, and RL-based decision making.
    • Developed agents for real-time decision-making, such as trading, gaming, customer support, or operations.
    • Track record of delivering end-to-end AI systems in fast-paced, high-scale environments (preferably finance, crypto, or high-frequency domains).

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in top-tier AI labs or Tech industry leaders
  • Experience in high-frequency trading, fintech, Web3, or crypto platforms is a strong advantage
  • Startups or research-intensive environments preferred; must be comfortable operating with ambiguity and speed

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
